title: Every state-changing action emits one audit record through one choke point
goal: Route every action that changes state or spends money - task and claim transitions, commits, pushes and merges, model calls, tool executions, file writes, egress attempts, approvals, secret access - through one dispatch point that emits exactly one structured record: actor, action kind, target, outcome, duration, cost, correlation id and a redaction marker. Reuse SusiAuditLogger and the gawd.audit.action topic instead of adding a second log, and reference the task, claim and evidence artifacts rather than duplicating them. Payloads never enter this tier: record what happened, not what was said or read.
